title: Quick Quenched Day-Stew
description: This funky, snappy, and sick-day Malaysian dish features a sweet and tangy yuzu-cure, making it a great choice for those looking for a low-FODMAP option. Serve it in a hot pot vessel for a fun and interactive meal.
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the yuzu puree, sugar, and salt to the saucepan, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
In a separate pot, bring the water to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cod fish to the hot pot vessel, and spoon some of the yuzu-cure over the top.
Place the hot pot vessel over the simmering water, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and freshly squeezed lime juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
To make the yuzu-cure, combine the yuzu puree, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Mix well to combine, and refrigerate until ready to use.
